checks: The concave roof realizes exactly the three interval products, with positive volumes 2ℓV, (2ℓ+4c)V, 2ℓV.

Every containing cap can be tightened through Y. Positive x coefficient gives an upper-tail pair and negative x coefficient gives its complementary lower-tail pair with null x-boundary slices. The same fixed base slope is used for w and −w, so the respective lower and upper paired bounds both yield B.
For zero x coefficient the projected measure is centrally symmetric about (0,0), including possible pure-base boundary atoms. Its closed cap mass is at least M/2≥B.

The strict A and perturbation bounds make opposite endpoint traces full/empty and keep both middle thresholds between −ℓ and ℓ+4c. Oddness of v under w↦−w gives middle mean retained length ℓ+c. The three cap masses equal B, including the boundary case c=ℓ for H_0.

The positive margin relation gives whole-space coverage, hence the upper bound at every mixed point. The listed witnesses are exclusive. Nonzero v and ε give rank two. Comparing the largest fiber with M/2 gives c<ℓ/2 exactly.
